/* Rigid photographic stage. A single image draw keeps architecture intact.
   Shared projection positions installations and atmosphere in the same image space. */
class TKDepthRenderer {
 constructor(canvas,stage){this.canvas=canvas;this.stage=stage;this.ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');this.cam={x:0,y:0,z:0,yaw:0,pitch:0};this.lastPose='';this.resize();new ResizeObserver(()=>this.resize()).observe(stage)}
 resize(){this.w=this.stage.clientWidth;this.h=this.stage.clientHeight;this.f=this.h*.94;this.dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,1.5);this.canvas.width=Math.round(this.w*this.dpr);this.canvas.height=Math.round(this.h*this.dpr);this.dirty=true;this.onLayout?.();if(this.img)this.draw(this.cam,true)}
 async setImage(src,realm){this.realm=realm;const img=new Image();img.src=src;await img.decode();if(this.realm!==realm)return;this.img=img;this.dirty=true;this.onLayout?.();this.draw(this.cam,true)}
 point(u,v){return {u,v,x:(u-.5)*30,y:(.5-v)*20,z:-30,d:30}}
 geometry(c=this.cam){const base=Math.max(this.w/this.img.width,this.h/this.img.height),zoom=1.12+Math.max(-.02,Math.min(.07,-c.z*.025)),iw=this.img.width*base*zoom,ih=this.img.height*base*zoom;const mx=Math.max(0,(iw-this.w)/2-2),my=Math.max(0,(ih-this.h)/2-2);return {iw,ih,x:(this.w-iw)/2+Math.max(-mx,Math.min(mx,c.yaw*this.w*.32-c.x*this.w*.012)),y:(this.h-ih)/2+Math.max(-my,Math.min(my,c.pitch*this.h*.32))}}
 project(p,c=this.cam){const g=this.geometry(c);return {x:g.x+p.u*g.iw,y:g.y+p.v*g.ih,d:30}}
 draw(c,force=false){this.cam={...c};if(!this.img)return;const pose=JSON.stringify(c);if(!force&&!this.dirty&&pose===this.lastPose)return;this.lastPose=pose;this.dirty=false;const t=performance.now(),g=this.geometry(c),ctx=this.ctx;ctx.setTransform(this.dpr,0,0,this.dpr,0,0);ctx.drawImage(this.img,g.x,g.y,g.iw,g.ih);this.canvas.dataset.renderer='rigid-image';this.canvas.dataset.frameMs=(performance.now()-t).toFixed(1);this.canvas.dataset.cameraZ=c.z.toFixed(3);this.canvas.dataset.cameraX=c.x.toFixed(3)}
}

root.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b)return;if(b.dataset.route)goScene(b.dataset.route);if(b.dataset.travel)goScene(b.dataset.travel);if(b.dataset.inspect)inspect(b.dataset.inspect);if(b.dataset.worldChapter)openChapter(b.dataset.worldChapter);if(b.dataset.map==='open')openMap();if(b.dataset.map==='close')closeMap();if(b.dataset.worldBack){const prev=history.length>1?history[history.length-2]:'shore';history=history.slice(0,-1);goScene(prev)}if(b.dataset.worldAction==='inspect')inspectNearest()});
stage.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(e.target.closest('button')||!canMove())return;drag={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,yaw:desired.yaw,pitch:desired.pitch,moved:false};stage.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);stage.focus({preventScroll:true})});stage.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!drag)return;if(Math.hypot(e.clientX-drag.x,e.clientY-drag.y)>5)drag.moved=true;desired.yaw=Math.max(-.22,Math.min(.22,drag.yaw+(e.clientX-drag.x)*.0012));desired.pitch=Math.max(-.12,Math.min(.12,drag.pitch-(e.clientY-drag.y)*.0008))});stage.addEventListener('pointerup',e=>{if(drag&&!drag.moved&&canMove()&&e.clientY>stage.clientHeight*.56){const dx=(e.clientX-stage.clientWidth/2)/stage.clientWidth;desired.x=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,desired.x+dx*.9));desired.z=Math.max(-2.6,desired.z-.65)}drag=null});stage.addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>drag=null);stage.addEventListener('dblclick',()=>desired={x:0,y:0,z:0,yaw:0,pitch:0});stage.addEventListener('wheel',e=>{if(e.target.closest('button')||!canMove())return;e.preventDefault();desired.z=Math.max(-2.6,Math.min(.8,desired.z+e.deltaY*.002))},{passive:false});
root.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.target.matches('input,textarea,[contenteditable]'))return;const k=e.key.toLowerCase();if(!mapDialog.hidden&&k==='tab'){const b=[...mapDialog.querySelectorAll('button')],i=b.indexOf(document.activeElement);e.preventDefault();b[(i+(e.shiftKey?-1:1)+b.length)%b.length].focus();return}if(k==='m'){e.preventDefault();mapDialog.hidden?openMap():closeMap();return}if(k==='escape'&&!mapDialog.hidden){closeMap();return}if(!canMove())return;if(['w','a','s','d','arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright','e'].includes(k)){e.preventDefault();keys.add(k);if(!e.repeat){if(k==='w'||k==='arrowup')desired.z-=.4;if(k==='s'||k==='arrowdown')desired.z+=.3;if(k==='a')desired.x-=.18;if(k==='d')desired.x+=.18;if(k==='arrowleft')desired.yaw+=.025;if(k==='arrowright')desired.yaw-=.025;if(k==='e')inspectNearest()}}});root.addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys.delete(e.key.toLowerCase()));window.addEventListener('blur',()=>{keys.clear();drag=null});document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)keys.clear()});qsa('[data-hold]').forEach(b=>{b.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();b.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);keys.add(b.dataset.hold)});['pointerup','pointercancel'].forEach(ev=>b.addEventListener(ev,()=>keys.delete(b.dataset.hold)))});
function renderCamera(force=false){depth.draw(cam,force);layoutPoints();qs('.tk-mini-player').style.transform=`translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(${-cam.yaw*180/Math.PI}deg)`}
function drawAtmosphere(t){const dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,1.2),w=stage.clientWidth,h=stage.clientHeight;if(weather.width!==w*dpr||weather.height!==h*dpr){weather.width=w*dpr;weather.height=h*dpr}const c=weatherCtx;c.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);c.clearRect(0,0,w,h);if(reduced||!depth.img)return;const time=t*.001;c.globalCompositeOperation='screen';
 if(current==='shore'||current==='atelier'||current==='observatory'||current==='atlas'){for(let i=0;i<62;i++){const u=current==='shore'?(i%2?.02+(i%23)*.009:.79+(i%19)*.01):.37+(i%25)*.009,v=current==='shore'?.52+(i%17)*.014:.48+(i%7)*.003;const p=depth.project(depth.point(u,v));const a=Math.max(0,Math.sin(time*.65+i*2.4))*.12;if(p.d>0){c.strokeStyle=`rgba(242,241,213,${a})`;c.lineWidth=.6;c.beginPath();const x=p.x+Math.sin(time*.2+i)*2;c.moveTo(x,p.y);c.lineTo(x+2+(i%5)*2,p.y+.2);c.stroke()}}}
 if(current!=='shore'){for(let i=0;i<23;i++){const x=((i*87.7+Math.sin(time*.035+i)*30)%w+w)%w,y=((i*61.3-time*(.7+i%3))%h+h)%h;c.fillStyle=`rgba(236,223,190,${.035+.04*Math.sin(time*.2+i)**2})`;c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,.45+(i%3)*.2,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill()}}
 c.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';}
const motionCtx=qs('.tk-motion-canvas').getContext('2d');function drawMotion(t){if(current!=='echo'||!motionCtx)return;const c=qs('.tk-motion-canvas'),w=stage.clientWidth,h=stage.clientHeight;if(c.width!==w||c.height!==h){c.width=w;c.height=h}motionCtx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);const time=reduced?0:t*.0002;for(let i=0;i<900;i++){const u=i/900*Math.PI*6,v=(i%23)/23*Math.PI*2;const x=w*.5+Math.sin(u+time)*w*.22+Math.sin(v+time*2)*28,y=h*.45+Math.cos(u*1.5+time*1.3)*h*.14+Math.cos(v+u)*30;motionCtx.fillStyle=`rgba(239,237,213,${.12+.25*(.5+.5*Math.sin(u*3+time))})`;motionCtx.fillRect(x,y,1.2,1.2)}}
function frame(t){raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);if(document.hidden)return;const dt=Math.min((t-lastTime)/1000,.05);lastTime=t;if(flight){const q=Math.min(1,(t-flight.start)/flight.duration),e=q*q*(3-2*q);Object.keys(cam).forEach(k=>cam[k]=flight.from[k]+(flight.to[k]-flight.from[k])*e);desired={...cam};if(q===1){const resolve=flight.resolve;flight=null;resolve()}}else{if(canMove()){const speed=dt*.85;if(keys.has('w')||keys.has('arrowup')){desired.x-=Math.sin(desired.yaw)*speed;desired.z-=Math.cos(desired.yaw)*speed}if(keys.has('s')||keys.has('arrowdown'))desired.z+=speed;if(keys.has('a'))desired.x-=speed;if(keys.has('d'))desired.x+=speed;if(keys.has('arrowleft'))desired.yaw+=dt*.15;if(keys.has('arrowright'))desired.yaw-=dt*.15;desired.x=Math.max(-1.1,Math.min(1.1,desired.x));desired.z=Math.max(-2.7,Math.min(1,desired.z));desired.yaw=Math.max(-.22,Math.min(.22,desired.yaw));if(desired.z<-2.3)goScene(scenes[current].next)}const ease=reduced?1:.085;Object.keys(cam).forEach(k=>cam[k]+=(desired[k]-cam[k])*ease)}renderCamera();if(t-lastPoseMs>45){drawAtmosphere(t);drawMotion(t);lastPoseMs=t}}
renderScene();raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);

window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{windows.forEach(({el})=>{if(el.hidden||el.classList.contains('tk-expanded'))return;const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.right>root.clientWidth||r.left<0){el.style.left=Math.max(0,root.clientWidth-el.offsetWidth-18)+'px';el.style.right='auto'}if(r.top>root.clientHeight-160)el.style.top='100px'})});
updateDock();
})();
